name: The Warrior
description: A marchguard with a spear, a shield, and the discipline to hold a line. Cairn has no classes, so the background and gear carry the archetype.

tables.marchguard-why-did-you-take-the-oath: Your life was saved by a member of the Marchguard, and you were inspired to join their ranks. Take a Snare Trap and a Sketchbook filled with detailed drawings.

fields.bond: I still wear the colours of a company that no longer exists, and I will not take them off.

name: The Witch
description: A half-witch who bargains with small spirits and knows which herbs to burn. Magic in Cairn is rare, dangerous, and carried in the pack.

fields.bond: A voice in the wood taught me one true thing, and I owe it a favour I have not yet been asked to repay.

name: The Surgeon
description: A barber-surgeon with steady hands, a sharp knife, and a bag of useful things. The party's best chance of surviving a bad night.

tables.barber-surgeon-how-have-you-improved-you: You have a replacement eye that can magnify objects, act as a telescope, and provide minimal night vision. You cannot wear anything metal on your head, and the presence of strong magnets make you deprived.

fields.bond: I keep a list of everyone I could not save, and I mean to make it shorter.
